angles.label: Timeline of the Nine Days of Contact
angles.description: Examine, broken out, the duration, time-of-day, and reply status of the 6 calls and 11 texts.

angles.label: The Purpose Inside the Message Wording
angles.description: Press on the purpose of the contacts via the absence of affectionate language and phrases like 'I really need to tell you something.'

angles.label: Going Around Ms. Song
angles.description: Ask why the contact went to the fiance directly instead of going through Ms. Song, and the responsibility for the indirect route.

angles.label: Reason for No Reply and Repetition
angles.description: Distinguish whether the rising count of contacts is obsession or repeated check-ins because of unanswered messages.

angles.label: Order of the Messages
angles.description: Confirm the start point, the late-night timing, and the reply order of the messages between the fiance and Ms. Choi.

angles.label: Boundary-Setting Reply and Distance
angles.description: Confirm the range and meaning of Ms. Choi's reply — whether it was reciprocation or distance-keeping.

angles.label: Reason the Capture Was Held Back
angles.description: Separate why Ms. Choi did not present the original right away, and why Ms. Song delayed checking it.

angles.label: Pressure of the Private Request
angles.description: Confirm any flow in which the fiance asked Ms. Choi for something behind Ms. Song's back, or pulled the conversation into private territory.

angles.label: Signal of the Father's Request
angles.description: Confirm what kind of message the wedding-prep check-in and the foreshadowing of a request truly were, without concluding yet.

angles.label: Money Concerns and Requests for Secrecy
angles.description: Confirm whether the request was leading to a money matter, and whether there was any ask to keep it from Ms. Song.

angles.label: A Flow That Looks Like the Past
angles.description: Step by step, ask whether the current message resembles a past money matter, without locking in a pattern early on.

angles.label: The Point Where the Father Was Set Aside
angles.description: Examine how Ms. Song treated her father's request as merely a family matter and noticed only late what was unsettling about it.

angles.label: The Gap in the Pre-Breakup KakaoTalk
angles.description: Examine the gap in the past chat between 'I will sort this out' and the actual cutoff.

angles.label: Flow of Transfers and Repayments
angles.description: Through three transfers, an IOU, partial repayment, and then loss of contact, confirm step by step the actual nature of the money matter.

angles.label: Silence That Was Meant to Protect
angles.description: Confirm why Ms. Choi could not tell Ms. Song about the past money matter and instead took on the villain role.

angles.label: The Weight of the IOU
angles.description: Confirm whether it was goodwill or a loan, and how the IOU and the partial repayment support Ms. Choi's silence and the reason for the cutoff.

angles.label: The First Post in the Group Chat
angles.description: Confirm the wording Ms. Song used to post in the group chat first, and whether public exposure preceded direct confirmation.

angles.label: Friends Joining In and Spreading the Take
angles.description: Confirm what wording the friends added in agreement, and how Ms. Song and Ms. Choi handled the spread.

angles.label: Repeated Villain Structure
angles.description: Sort out the structure where Ms. Choi was left as the villain, in both the past and the present, and Ms. Song concluded first.

angles.label: Public Posting Without Verification
angles.description: Confirm whether Ms. Song posted in the group chat before checking with Ms. Choi, and whether there was a chance to correct it after going public.
